name: chapter_8
title: Introduction to Articles
description: This chapter introduces the use of articles 'a', 'an', and 'the' in English and explains when to use each one.

options.A: He saw an elephant at the zoo.
options.B: He saw an dog at the zoo.
options.C: He saw an cat at the zoo.
options.D: He saw an bird at the zoo.

options.A: The sun rises in the east.

options.B: Before nouns starting with a consonant sound.
options.C: Before nouns starting with a vowel sound.
